title: Powers of extended constant ideal sections
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme, $A$ any commutative ring, and $I\subseteq A$ any ideal. Use the coefficient sheaf and kernel ideal of [def-weil-pbc-torsion-completion-sheaf-model]. For every object $U$, every section $f\in\underline A(U)$ in the image of the extended ideal inclusion, and every $n\in\mathbb N$, the section $f^n$ is in the image of the extended $I^n$ inclusion. This includes $n=0$.

source.place: Tag 099P (section-derived-completion-proetale), first list item; constant sheafification local lifting and ideal powers.

proof.text: Evaluation preserves kernels of module sheaves. Identify the evaluated kernel with the concrete kernel of the evaluated module quotient, and calculate that this quotient acts on sections as the ring quotient.

Cover U by the image sieve of the constant-presheaf sheafification unit at f. On every member lift f to a coefficient a. If the empty sieve covers that member, separatedness proves every required section equality. Otherwise local injectivity of the constant sheafification unit gives a in I from its zero quotient section. Then a^n belongs to I^n by Ideal.pow_mem_pow. Naturality and preservation of powers show the quotient of f^n is zero locally. Separatedness gives zero globally, and the kernel comparison supplies the required section.
